text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...It brings back memories—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing her gum in the waiting room,
Bubble Gum Fellow was focused more intensely than ever...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: GⅠs really are amazing, aren't they...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"My body is trembling like never before.
And my heart is just bursting with excitement, tooâ"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I want to run so badly, I can't help it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even on the grand stage of her very first GⅠ,
there's no trace of nervousness—only overflowing fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As for me, on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, are you nervous by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a rookie Trainer,
today is my very first GⅠ race,
just like it is for Bubble Gum Fellow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took pride in knowing Bubble Gum Fellow was fully prepared.
So I intended for us to face it with confidence, but—
choice_data_list: (No matter what, my heart won't stop racing—)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm okay, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I don't get nervous at all, you know.
Part of the reason I chew bubblegum is to help keep myself calm.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Still, in a crunch like this,
what you can count on most in the end is—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: It's the time we've spent together leading up to today.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The time spent striving to blaze a trail...
The moments shared alongside someone chasing the same dream—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Every time I remember, it gives me
the strength to let my dreams grow bigger...!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So have faith, Trainer.
In the time we've spent working together up to today.
And in your own hard work.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run today believing in that too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I bump my fist against her outstretched one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――My heart was at peace.

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: "It's finally here—the Asahi Hai FS. ...Bubble's certainly drawing all the spotlight, as expected."

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I'm getting nervous just through the phone...! Bubble-chan is seriously amazing at times like this. She can just dive right in all on her own, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. She is always one step ahead,
before we even begin to take our first stride..."

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
"Do your best, Bubble.
Even if we are apart, our hearts are one—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...!
Bubble Gum Fellow looks so dignified.
He's already got quite the presence...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
...Hrrrm, I wonder why.
Her vibe is completely different, but for some reason
she keeps reminding me of Fuji Kiseki...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Now then, let's burst wide open...!
